name.en-US: The Herald of Divine Love, Book II
name.pt-BR: O Arauto do Amor Divino, Livro II

description.la: Liber secundus, ab ipsa Gertrude conscriptus: gratiae acceptae anno aetatis vicesimo sexto, visitationes Domini, vulnera amoris, gratiarum actio.
description.en-US: Book II, written by Gertrude herself: the grace received in her twenty-sixth year, the Lord's visitations, the wound of love, thanksgiving.
description.pt-BR: Livro II, escrito pela própria Gertrudes: a graça recebida aos vinte e seis anos, as visitas do Senhor, a ferida do amor, a ação de graças.

sources.edition: Revelationes Gertrudianae ac Mechtildianae, vol. I, Poitiers/Paris: H. Oudin, 1875 (Solesmes edition), as transcribed in IntraText LAT0714.
sources.description: IntraText edition (EuloTech 2007), Books I-II only. The edition's [p. N] page marks are dropped and the paragraph numbers [N] become paragraph breaks (research/sourcing/_scripts/gertrude_legatus12.py).
sources.tierEvidence: IntraText is licensed under a Creative Commons license; the underlying 1875 text is public domain.
